newsitem.title: USA: USDA ups 1997/98 EU sugar output to 17.6 mln tonne.
newsitem.headline: USDA ups 1997/98 EU sugar output to 17.6 mln tonne.

text.p: The U.S. Agriculture Department slightly raised its forecast of 1997/98 sugar production in the European Union to 17.6 million tonnes on Friday.
Earlier in May, USDA pegged the crop at 17.4 million tonnes. In either case, output would be down four percent from the previous year.

"This forecast reflects the dry weather conditions in northern Europe and assumes that there will not be a repeat of the favorable autumn rains that boosted production in the 1996/97 season," USDA said in its periodic "Sugar: World Markets and Trade" report.
Exports during 1997/98 were forecast at 5.2 million tonnes, down 10 percent from 1996/97. Imports were pegged at 1.6 million tonnes for 1997/98, unchanged from the current year.
